note: Short stature and microcephaly are reported as consistent co-occurring cardinal features across MAU2-related CdLS cohorts, making symmetric cranial-somatic growth restriction plausible.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 18 individuals with pathogenic MAU2 variants, short stature and microcephaly were consistent features alongside somatic growth delay, supporting linked cranial and somatic restriction.

source.title: Pathogenic variants in the cohesin loader subunit MAU2 lead to a new Cornelia de Lange Syndrome subtype
source.quote: Affected individuals display a wide range of phenotypes, from classic CdLS to milder presentations, with short stature and microcephaly as consistent features.

evidence.text: Cohesin spectrum review notes that MAU2 and related non-classic cohesin variants can present with milder growth delay and lower frequencies of postnatal growth retardation and microcephaly compared to classical NIPBL-CdLS.

source.title: Cornelia de Lange spectrum
source.quote: Growth delay is not as significant, with a lower frequency of postnatal growth retardation and microcephaly
